note: Melton Building Society Annual Report and Accounts 2025, year to 31 December 2025, Group. Unlike the 2024 report, this one has no capital table: the business review on p19 states only CET1 capital 'increasing to £41.7m', CET1 ratio 13.6% (down from 14.1%), leverage ratio 'remained at 5.4%' and 'The Society has no tier 2 capital', so total capital equals CET1 and the total capital ratio equals the CET1 ratio (as in the 2024 table). TCR set by the PRA 24.6m. LCR 393% at 31 December from p18. No RWA amount or leverage exposure is stated anywhere in the document (note 31 'Capital' p137 is narrative only); the implied RWA would be about 41.7/0.136 = 307, but it is not recorded since it is not stated. No NSFR.
